subdomains.name: Decay Subdomain (Plant)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Bramble Armor with Aura of Decay and replace the Plant domain's 3rd-, 4th-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Wooden Fist
powers.summary: As a free action, make unarmed strikes without provoking attacks of opportunity, deal lethal damage, and add half cleric level to damage. Usable for rounds per day equal to 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Decay
powers.summary: As a standard action, emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Living creatures other than you take 1d6 damage and a cumulative -1 Strength penalty each round; plants take 2d6 damage.

subdomains.name: Growth Subdomain (Plant)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Wooden Fist with Enlarge and replace the Plant domain's 1st- and 5th-level spells.

powers.name: Enlarge
powers.summary: As a swift action, enlarge yourself for 1 round as enlarge person. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Bramble Armor
powers.summary: As a free action, grow thorns that deal 1d6 piercing damage plus 1 per two cleric levels to creatures striking you with unarmed or non-reach melee attacks. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Deception Subdomain (Trickery)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Copycat with Sudden Shift and replace the Trickery domain's 2nd- and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Sudden Shift
powers.summary: As an immediate action after a melee attack misses you, teleport up to 10 feet to a visible space within the attacker's reach. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Master's Illusion
powers.summary: As a standard action, create a veil-like illusion affecting you and allies within 30 feet. Usable for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Thievery Subdomain (Trickery)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Master's Illusion with Thief of the Gods and replace the Trickery domain's 3rd- and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Copycat
powers.summary: As a move action, create one mirror image that lasts for rounds equal to cleric level or until destroyed. Only one can exist at a time. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Thief of the Gods
powers.summary: As a free action, roll a Disable Device or Sleight of Hand check twice and take the higher result. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per two levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Blood Subdomain (War)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Weapon Master with Wounding Blade and replace the War domain's 3rd-, 5th-, and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Battle Rage
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant a bonus on melee damage rolls equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Wounding Blade
powers.summary: Give a touched weapon the wounding special quality for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Tactics Subdomain (War)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Battle Rage with Seize the Initiative and replace the War domain's 2nd-, 5th-, and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Seize the Initiative
powers.summary: When you and your allies roll initiative, let one ally within 30 feet roll twice and choose either result before results are revealed. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Weapon Master
powers.summary: As a swift action, gain the use of one combat feat whose prerequisites you meet. Usable for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level, and the feat can change each activation.

subdomains.name: Ice Subdomain (Water)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Cold Resistance with Body of Ice and replace the Water domain's 7th- and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Icicle
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 cold damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Body of Ice
powers.summary: As a standard action, become immune to cold and gain DR 5/— while taking double fire damage. End as a free action; usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Oceans Subdomain (Water)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Icicle with Surge and replace the Water domain's 2nd-, 3rd-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Surge
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a combat maneuver check using cleric level + Wisdom modifier to push or pull one creature as a bull rush or drag. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Cold Resistance
powers.summary: Gain cold resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.

subdomains.name: Seasons Subdomain (Weather)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Storm Burst with Untouched by the Seasons and replace the Weather domain's 1st-, 4th-, and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Untouched by the Seasons
powers.summary: Touch a creature to grant endure elements for 1 hour per cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Lightning Lord
powers.summary: Call down a number of lightning bolts per day equal to cleric level. Any number may be used with one standard action, but each creature can be targeted only once and targets must be within 30 feet of each other; otherwise functions as call lightning.

subdomains.name: Storms Subdomain (Weather)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Lightning Lord with Gale Aura and replace the Weather domain's 5th- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Storm Burst
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. Deal 1d6 nonlethal damage plus 1 per two cleric levels and impose a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Gale Aura
powers.summary: As a standard action, create a 30-foot aura where creatures cannot take 5-foot steps and enemies treat squares moving closer to you as difficult terrain. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.
